30:def length_of_largest_common_substring(str1: str, str2: str) -> int:

46:    # Variables to keep track of maximum length and ending position

51:        for j in range(1, len(str2) + 1):
52:            if str1[i - 1] == str2[j - 1]:
53:                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
54:                if dp[i][j] > max_length:
55:                    max_length = dp[i][j]
